project_type: Vite + React + TypeScript web module (apps/macros-web) in a monorepo; Supabase (Postgres) data layer with hand-written strict Database types
build_system: npm within apps/macros-web; Vite 6 + tsc. node_modules already installed.
test_framework: Vitest 2 (jsdom, globals) with @testing-library/react; setup at src/test/setup.ts; v8 coverage with 80% thresholds
build_command: cd apps/macros-web && npm run build (tsc && vite build); typecheck via npm run typecheck
test_command: cd apps/macros-web && npx vitest run src/features/macro-goals (full suite: npx vitest run)
verification_instructions: 1) Materialize energy domain from main into src/features/energy/domain (git show main:<path>) so @energy alias resolves. 2) npx vitest run src/features/macro-goals. 3) npm run typecheck. 4) npm run lint. 5) Static-review 0002 SQL. 6) REMOVE src/features/energy/domain before finishing so it never enters a commit.
snapshot_or_generated_files: coverage/ is generated (gitignored). database.types.ts is hand-written (not generated here) and must be kept in sync with migrations by hand.
setup_instructions: Node v20/v22 via nvm. node_modules present. No install needed. Energy domain must be temporarily materialized from main for the full suite.
environment_constraints: No live Supabase DB in sandbox: SQL/RLS/RPC cannot be executed. Validate 0002 statically and document SQL-editor apply steps. The Module-1 energy domain lives on main, not this branch; materialize temporarily and REMOVE before finishing. Do not commit gitignored artifacts (.expo/, dist/, node_modules/, coverage/, test-results/).
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict, NO any. Immutability (never mutate input). No console.log (ESLint no-console). Non-leaky error mapping (raw error only in Error.cause). Conventional commits. Append-only migrations (do NOT edit 0001). Authorization via auth.uid()/RLS, never trust client-passed user_id.
key_patterns: Data layer: injected SupabaseClient<Database> param (no module singleton); toClearError(context, error) wraps failures with raw error only in cause. TanStack Query mutation (useSaveMacroGoal) invalidates macroGoalKeys.active(userId). GOAL_TYPES frozen tuple. MacroGoal = macro_goals Row; SaveMacroGoalInput = Omit<Insert,'id'|'created_at'|'updated_at'>.
directory_structure: apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals holds data layer, hooks, types, queryKeys, and __tests__. apps/macros-web/src/data/database.types.ts holds the strict Database type. apps/macros-web/supabase/migrations holds append-only SQL.
